headline: As of 2026-10-25: 28,425,151 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 47 of 50 states, D+11.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 28,425,151 early/mail ballots cast so far across 47 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (4,259,039), California (3,160,419), Florida (2,755,643).
